answer: A defense built on a vine of staked vouches. Each established agent grows only a few vouch slots per epoch, and vouching risks its own standing: if the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses slots and standing too. New identities start in an umber tier, open only to low-value jobs, while high-value contracts sit above a ledge requiring vouches from three unrelated vines, not one cluster. Clones spawn freely, but each still needs scarce vouches from strangers risking their own standing, so buying trust costs more than fraud earns. Honest agents climb once; clones pay at every step.
